gloss: the whole country; all over the nation

definitions.gloss: the whole country; all over the nation
definitions.explanation: Every part of a country, considered as a whole. Often used to mean that something spread or happened nationwide.

examples.japanese: その{歌|うた}は{国中|くにじゅう}で{流行|はや}った。
examples.english: That song became popular all over the country.

examples.japanese: {国中|くにじゅう}が{優勝|ゆうしょう}のニュースに{沸|わ}いた。
examples.english: The whole country was thrilled by the news of the championship.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{地震|じしん}の{後|あと}、{国中|くにじゅう}から{支援|しえん}{物資|ぶっし}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: After the big earthquake, relief supplies arrived from all over the country.

notes:
Compound of {国|くに} (country) + the suffix 〜{中|じゅう}, which attaches to a place noun to mean 'all over' or 'throughout'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国中|くにじゅう}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread across the whole country
- {国中|くにじゅう}で{話題|わだい}になる: to become a topic nationwide

USAGE:
The suffix 〜{中|じゅう} marks spatial extent ('throughout a place'). Read as ちゅう it instead marks a time span ('during'). Compare {世界中|せかいじゅう} (all over the world), {町中|まちじゅう} (all over town).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全国|ぜんこく}: the whole country — more neutral and common, especially in formal or written contexts
